layer_at_fault_line: Row 13 marks the motto "The cross will always be saved" as Fixed although the report's own note says it only "asserts the outcome; it holds no part" -- an asserted part should take whatever mark holds it, not Fixed; reporting.md's line 'The owner put this part outside the test, and said so' reads, to a reader marking a document, as naming the story's own claimant (Father Brown) rather than a real owner in dialogue with the tester.
